title: A sheaf of sets on a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens is a directed colimit of finitely presented sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal B$ a basis of the topology of $X$ such that every $U\in\mathcal B$ is quasi-compact. For an open $U\subseteq X$ and a set $S$ let $j_{U!}\underline S$ be the extension by the empty set [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty] of the sheaf $\underline S_U$ of locally constant maps to $S$ on $U$. Coproducts and coequalizers below are colimits in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X$. Then there are a directed set $\Lambda$ (nonempty, any two elements have a common upper bound), a system of sheaves of sets $(\mathcal F_\lambda,\varphi_{\mu\lambda}:\mathcal F_\lambda\to\mathcal F_\mu)_{\lambda\le\mu}$ on $X$ over $\Lambda$ ($\varphi_{\lambda\lambda}=\mathrm{id}$, $\varphi_{\nu\mu}\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=\varphi_{\nu\lambda}$) and morphisms $c_\lambda:\mathcal F_\lambda\to\mathcal F$ with $c_\mu\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=c_\lambda$, such that $(\mathcal F,(c_\lambda)_\lambda)$ is a colimit of the system in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$, and such that for every $\lambda\in\Lambda$ there are integers $m,n\ge0$, elements $U_1,\dots,U_n,V_1,\dots,V_m\in\mathcal B$, finite sets $S_1,\dots,S_n,T_1,\dots,T_m$, two morphisms $\beta,\gamma:\coprod_{b=1}^mj_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to\coprod_{a=1}^nj_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ and a morphism $q:\coprod_{a=1}^nj_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}\to\mathcal F_\lambda$ such that $(\mathcal F_\lambda,q)$ is a coequalizer of $\beta,\gamma$.
